what: Every lowering panics in salsa: "cannot create a tracked struct disambiguator outside of a tracked function" (vendor/salsa/src/zalsa_local.rs:481). base_db::Db::maintain (crates/base-db/src/maintain.rs:361, reached from set_all_crates_with_durability via blaze_lower::lower_into) runs hir_def::nameres::delta::maintain -> maintain_all -> maintain_crate -> cutoff -> run::run_in -> facts::macros::resolve_round -> collect_expansion -> ModCollector::push_child_module, which calls ModuleIdLt::new (crates/hir-def/src/nameres/facts/collect.rs:1684), a salsa tracked struct, with no tracked function on the query stack. Fails blaze-engine as_rustc::tests::{autocfg_probes, rustix_writes_to_standard_output, type_error_fails_as_rustc, unknown_feature_fails, anyhow_backtrace_probe} (cargo-test3.log, HEAD 15:00) and any blaze-lower caller. Fix at the owner: make the maintainer create module ids through an interned/input id or inside a tracked fn, not tracked-struct new outside one. tests-engine reruns the 5 blaze-engine tests once done.
